sections.overview: Macrophyllum macrophyllum is a small leaf-nosed bat of the Americas.
sections.identification: Long hind limbs and tail set it apart from similar small bats.
sections.habitat: It roosts near water in forests, caves, culverts and tunnels.
sections.diet: It eats mainly insects, including flying and aquatic species; fish hunting is unconfirmed.
sections.behavior: Echolocation guides its fluttering flight over water.
sections.reproduction: Females give birth to one young; breeding-season data are sparse.
sections.ecology: It may affect local populations of aquatic insects.
sections.conservation: Animal Diversity Web reports the global IUCN category as Least Concern. Argentina's 2019 assessment classified it as Data Deficient nationally.
